# Historical completed-run fixture

The adjacent JSON stores the exact pre-Task 9 controller bytes from public runtime
commit `73b2ed61ee44f16bcdd7ab483cedc771ae145f5e`. `tree_base64` preserves all 12,831
bytes, including the original absence of a trailing newline. Its decoded SHA-256
is `a0e56bc52f341484cb19fa7f8e54eab3159ae160ce7774cd6f67729f95e6a2a6`.

The history contains a genuine terminal command reservation and result, not a
legacy admission synthesized by current helpers. The command printed
`historical v1 completed run`. It consumed one run and left the first reserved
move awaiting its journal acknowledgement. The history has ten public service
events and no computation digest. Its absolute paths and process identities are
historical provenance, never executable instructions for this regression.

`files` contains the referenced immutable content, historical filesystem effect
acknowledgements, and the native sample workspace used by the subsequent bounded
compatibility characterization. The workspace job text may reflect that later
characterization; the test supplies its own new job before exercising current
execution. The frozen history and its archived input/result bytes remain exact.
Neither current amendment records nor current run events replace the old tree.

The fixture was captured on 2026-09-06 using the historical public `init`,
proposal/review/admit, guarded native plan, `begin`, and `run` operations. The
regression restores it only to its disposable test workspace. It asserts pure
replay, refusal of an unamended new run, and a reviewed amendment followed by
one new controlled command without resetting the earlier account charge.
Synthetic reviews in this fixture test software authorization only.
